detail.longDescription:
Nora VPN is a fast and secure VPN for Android that connects with one tap, needs no sign-up, and works on mobile data and Wi‑Fi. A fast VPN and stable VPN proxy for everyday browsing, streaming and gaming.

Why Nora VPN?
• Stable connection: if a server is busy, the app moves to a less crowded one automatically.
• Fast VPN: optimized routing for mobile networks and Wi‑Fi; a fast VPN that stays usable on slow connections.
• No sign-up: no email, no phone number, no account. Install and connect.
• Lightweight: small app size, works well on older phones and slow networks.
• Smart server selection: the app picks the server that works best on your network.
• Privacy-respecting: built to protect your personal privacy.

Secure VPN proxy
Traffic between your phone and the server goes through a secure VPN tunnel. Nora VPN uses the official Android VpnService only to create a private, secure connection and is built to respect your privacy; see the Data safety section for details.

Made for everyday use
Use Nora VPN for social media and messaging apps, video streaming, and online games.

Works on your phone
Compatible with Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, Nokia and other Android devices. A free VPN app for Android that doesn't take much space.

How to use
1. Install Nora VPN.
2. Open the app and tap Connect.
3. Done. The connection status is shown on the main screen.

FAQ
+ It won't connect. Tap disconnect and connect again; the app picks a suitable server itself. If your carrier's internet is weak, try Wi‑Fi.
+ Is it free? Yes. Nora VPN is free.
+ What about my privacy? Nora VPN is built to respect your personal privacy.

Nora VPN is for people who want a fast, secure and simple VPN that just works every day. If you are looking for a VPN for Android, a private VPN app, or a VPN proxy that changes your IP address, try Nora VPN.

Legal use and transparency
Nora VPN is built for lawful use such as protecting your privacy on public networks and does not enable or promote illegal activity.

Note: please use VPN services in accordance with the laws of your country.
